name: 奧瑞恩男性偏武 · 單手武器與盾
prompt: Production 2D hand-painted fantasy RPG animation sprite atlas. SQUARE RGB OPAQUE PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no alpha. EXACT 6 columns by 6 rows, thirty-six SEPARATE full-body miniature sprites. Same person, costume, weapon, scale and right-facing three-quarter view every frame. Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: athletic adult European-looking man with short chestnut hair, polished blue-grey plate shoulders and cuirass, cream and royal blue surcoat with gold sun trim, brown gauntlets and armoured boots. Held equipment MUST be: a one-handed saber in right hand and a small ROUND SHIELD strapped to left forearm. SIX ROWS, each six frames: ROW1 idle breathing loop; ROW2 attack: ready, anticipation, windup, strong contact/release, follow-through, recovery. Brace shield, draw saber back and make forceful diagonal cut past shield then recover; guard MUST raise shield, not saber. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: athletic adult European-looking man with short chestnut hair, polished blue-grey plate shoulders and cuirass, cream and royal blue surcoat with gold sun trim, brown gauntlets and armoured boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency. 6 columns, 6 rows, 36 poses.
